description: The first-order part of a second-order formula is translated recursively into the application language, guarding all internal individual quantifiers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.translateFirstOrder.{u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {k : ℕ} :
  L.BoundedFormula ℕ k →
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.applicationLanguage L).BoundedFormula
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Name k
